mattress_summary: Four Queen mattresses that meet the applied ≥8-inch, coil-free, natural-latex, cotton-outer and no-disclosed-synthetic-foam rubric. This rubric comes from generated summaries of two X posts—not recovered original post text—and is not health or exposure evidence.
bedding_summary: Every setup includes fitted + flat sheets, at least two pillowcases, a duvet cover and the actual insert. Quince percale is the strongest coordinated value; IKEA + wool costs less.
context: Criteria lead: Grok’s X lookup returned generated summaries (not original post text) for AlpacaAurelius and SolBrah. The dashboard applies the stated construction preferences—no coil support, natural latex, cotton outer, no disclosed synthetic foam, and at least 8 inches—but does not treat the posts as proof of EMF, testosterone, off-gassing, PFAS, microplastic, or health claims.

All four displayed mattresses meet the construction rubric at the manufacturer-disclosed layer level. ‘No synthetic foam’ means no polyurethane, memory foam, or synthetic latex was listed in the main layers; it is not a complete bill of materials for thread, zipper, labels, adhesives, packaging, or other minor components.

No verified all-wool Queen mattress at least 8 inches thick was found in the bounded source refresh. Home of Wool describes its wool mattresses as up to 7 inches, so wool-only models are not presented as meeting the thickness preference.

Temperature and fit remain individual. Seller language about wool/cotton temperature regulation and latex airflow is not a personal cooling guarantee. Prices are USD before tax; arrival is not ZIP-quoted.
